name: Multiloca Lite – Multi Locations Inventory Management
author: Techspawn

sections.description:
Multiloca Lite allows you to manage your WooCommerce product inventory across multiple physical locations and display this information to your customers.

Whether you have multiple warehouses, retail stores, or distribution centers, this plugin makes it easy to track and display stock levels at each location.

Key Features

  • Multiple Locations: Create and manage unlimited locations and location groups.
  • Location-Based Inventory: Track stock quantities for each product at each location.
  • Frontend Display: Show location stock levels to customers on product pages.
  • Multiple Display Options: Choose from various display styles including table, list, card, and more.
  • Custom CSS: Add your own styling through the settings panel.
  • Location Information: Add address, contact details, and other information to each location.
  • Shortcodes: Display location information anywhere on your site.

Pro Features

Looking for more advanced features? Check out our Pro version which includes:

  • Order fulfillment rules based on location
  • Auto-detect customer location and show nearest stock
  • Location selection during checkout
  • Shipping and payment methods per location
  • Location-specific pricing
  • Auto stock allocation
  • Location manager roles and permissions
  • And much more!

Premium Features

Looking for Enterprise level features? Check out our Premium version which includes:

  • All features in Pro version
  • Rule based automatic & advanced location fullfillment for orders
  • Create & Manage vendors and Purchase orders.
  • Initiaze stock transfers between locations
  • And much more!
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/multiloca-lite directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Products > Locations to create your locations.
  4. Edit products to set stock levels for each location.
  5. Configure display options under Settings > Multiloca Lite.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with WooCommerce?

Yes, Multiloca Lite requires WooCommerce to be installed and activated.

How many locations can I create?

You can create and manage unlimited locations in both the lite and pro versions.

Can customers select a location during checkout?

This feature is available in the pro version only. The lite version focuses on displaying inventory information.

Can I display location information on product pages?

Yes, location inventory displays automatically on product pages. You can also use shortcodes to display location information anywhere.
